title: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Soil Moisture, Daily 9 km (SPL3SMP_E v6)
description: Daily global composite of surface soil moisture (approximately the top 5 cm) retrieved from NASA Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) L-band radiometer brightness temperatures, posted on the 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0, with separate 6:00 a.m. (descending) and 6:00 p.m. (ascending) local-time fields. The companion model–data assimilation product SMAP L4 (SPL4SMGP v8) provides 3-hourly surface and root-zone soil moisture at 9 km.
purpose: Provides observation-based near-surface soil moisture since March 2015 for monitoring agricultural drought onset and rainfall response in the cereal-growing High Plateaux and Tell, complementing rainfall- and model-based indicators.

variables.name: soil_moisture / soil_moisture_pm
variables.description: Surface soil moisture (about 0–5 cm) from the baseline Dual Channel Algorithm (DCA), 6 a.m. descending and 6 p.m. ascending composites

variables.name: soil_moisture_scav, soil_moisture_scah
variables.description: Alternative retrievals from the single-channel V- and H-polarisation algorithms

variables.name: retrieval_qual_flag
variables.description: Retrieval quality; values 0 or 8 indicate recommended-quality retrievals

variables.name: tb_h_corrected, tb_v_corrected
variables.description: Water-corrected brightness temperatures resampled to 9 km

processing: SMAP antenna temperatures are converted to brightness temperatures with Backus-Gilbert optimal interpolation and posted to the 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0 (L1C). Level-2 soil moisture is retrieved with the Dual Channel Algorithm (baseline since Version 5) and single-channel alternatives, then composited daily using the observations closest to 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. local solar time. Version 6 applies an improved processing of the input enhanced L2 brightness temperatures.
limitations: Represents only about the top 5 cm of soil; root-zone conditions require the model-based SPL4SMGP product.

Retrievals are flagged as uncertain or not retrieved over steep, variable topography (mountainous flag: slope standard deviation above 3° flagged, above 6° not retrieved), urban fractions above 0.25, open water and frozen ground.
Valid soil_moisture range starts at 0.02 m3/m3; very dry desert soils sit near this lower bound, limiting dynamic range.
Enhanced 9 km posting is interpolated from a radiometer footprint much coarser than 9 km, so adjacent pixels are not independent.
Radio-frequency interference can contaminate L-band observations; the radiometer applies detection and mitigation but residual effects are possible.

algeria_notes: SMAP is most informative over the semi-arid High Plateaux and interior Tell plains, where L-band sensing through sparse vegetation works well. Tell Atlas, Aurès and Kabylie relief will trigger mountainous flags, coastal pixels can be affected by the sea, and over the hyper-arid Sahara values stay near the 0.02 m3/m3 floor except after rare rain events. Always filter on retrieval_qual_flag.
